children: TOKYO, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Japanese wholesale prices rose 7.6 percent in the year to August, Bank of Japan data showed on Friday.[JPCGPY=ECI]    The rise in the corporate goods price index (CGPI), which measures the price companies charge eachother for their goods and services, compares with the median market forecast for a 7.4 percent annual increase andfollows a 7.7 percent annual increase in July.    Details were as follows (preliminary, with percentage change; economists' median forecast in parentheses; previous figures may be revised):                 AUG        JULY     JUNE   AUG INDEXYear-on-year +7.6 (+7.4)    +7.7     +7.4   +136.1Mth-on-mth    -0.2 (0.0)    +0.4     +0.5  To view the full tables, go to  http://www.boj.or.jp/en/statistics/pi/cgpi_release/index.htm/
